claims: Continue invasive mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings, targeting plateau pressure ≤30 cmH2O and appropriate PEEP; reassess oxygenation and consider weaning readiness given current CPAP/PSV trial.
Continue continuous IV sedation with midazolam and fentanyl, titrating to target RASS -1 to 0 and reassessing daily for sedation interruption and extubation readiness.
Monitor and manage fever (up to 101.7°F) with serial temperature checks, cultures if not already obtained, and antipyretic therapy as needed.
Monitor heart rate (tachycardic to 126 bpm) with continuous telemetry and evaluate for causes including pain, fever, agitation, or arrhythmia.
Obtain blood cultures and consider additional infectious workup given fever and leukocytosis, and initiate or adjust empiric antibiotics per institutional protocol.
Recheck serum potassium given prior hyperkalemia (6.2 mEq/L) and monitor electrolytes (magnesium, phosphate, calcium) with replacement as needed.
Monitor blood glucose closely given recent hypoglycemia (64 mg/dL) and insulin administration; adjust insulin and dextrose to maintain glucose in target range.
Perform daily sedation interruption and spontaneous breathing trial assessment to evaluate readiness for extubation.
Provide stress ulcer prophylaxis and venous thromboembolism prophylaxis (heparin already active) per ICU protocol.
Maintain head-of-bed elevation, oral care with subglottic suctioning, and cuff pressure monitoring to prevent ventilator-associated pneumonia.
